layout.title: 115″ wall TV · 6-seat L sectional · Aries ottoman with walnut tray
notes: Main run 104″ (y 36–140), 4″ off the west glass: 4″ short of the balcony door, south seat’s legroom 4″ clear of the column.
Two 28½″ main seats and the corner face the TV square on at 14–15½ ft; three 34″ return seats face the lake and turn 44–64° to the screen.

Coffee table: Living Spaces Aries II cocktail ottoman, 66 × 27 × 18″, with the 30 × 24″ MAGIGO walnut tray (both from ideas/README.md, both deliver to Austin); 16″ from both seat fronts. A C-shaped side table slides over the east arm.

115″ TV (101.4″ wide, about 160 lb) on a stud-mounted low-profile bracket, centered at y 59, screen center 50″ up: 4.5″ clear of the switch plate. Solar or blackout shades in the 4″ behind the sofa cut west-glass glare.

scores.grok-4.7: pending when the owner capped the TV at 98 inches; superseded

findings: terra: no material change; 9 not 10 only because the tested alternatives do not prove nothing better exists.
sonnet: deducted 1.0 for the three side seats and 0.25 for the island aisle with stools occupied, while finding no buildable alternative that fixes either.
Legend, side-table note, rug label and TV width (101.2 modeled vs 101.4 sold) were inconsistent; fixed.
Column y, stud positions and the door jamb need tape checks before ordering.
outcome: Owner capped the TV at 98 inches after this round, so the layouts were re-optimized.
